newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: AMMB stock jumps after strong earnings.
newsitem.headline: AMMB stock jumps after strong earnings.

text.p: The stock of Malaysian financial services concern AMMB Holdings Bhd jumped in early trading after reporting strong earnings for the 1996/97 year.
Around 0200 GMT, the stock was up 40 cents to 16.80 ringgit on volume of 221,800 traded.
The company reported late on Wednesday that net profit of 559.7 million ringgit for the year ended March 31, 1997, against 327.0 million the previous year, beating market forecasts.
Its finance company subsidiary, Arab-Malaysian Finance Bhd, rose 20 cents to 6.50.
